Senses.Explanation: To see only one side is a repeated verdict on a partial account. Yunmen Cheng and Lianfeng Su attach it to the Xu-Liu shoulder-board comparison; Yuan’an applies it to a cited explanation of letting go; Baichi applies it equally to praise and slander.
